summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney with a currency parameter using Intl.NumberFormat, and lets invoiceLines take a currency.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still used by cart
findings.problem: This change removes the formatPrice export from src/money.ts. The cartTotal function in src/cart.ts still imports and calls formatPrice at lines 1 and 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails on src/cart.ts. Customers cannot see the cart total until someone fixes the import.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Or keep formatPrice as a wrapper around formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: The new formatMoney output adds thousands separators and supports other currencies. No test in the repository checks formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Later changes to money formatting can change invoice text without anyone noticing.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines with large amounts and a non-USD currency.
